title: Floating Point Pennies
description: can_afford(prices, budget) returns True if the total of prices (in dollars) fits in the budget. A customer with exactly enough money gets turned away.
code:
def can_afford(prices, budget):
    return sum(prices) <= budget
explanation: Floats are stored in binary, and most decimal fractions can't be represented exactly: `0.1 + 0.2` is `0.30000000000000004`, which is more than `0.3`. For money, work in whole cents (integers) or use `decimal.Decimal`.
